vocab.title: Because of Winn-Dixie
vocab.groupsNote: The Oct 30 academic vocabulary quiz covers the four green words: Trustworthy, Constellations, Irritating, and Distracted. Other words are retained for review.

words.sentence: We bought fresh produce at the market.
words.fill: The ___ aisle has apples and carrots.

words.def: A case where a rule does not apply
words.sentence: The extra recess was an exception to the rule.
words.fill: Pets are not allowed in the library, but a guide dog is an ___.

words.def: When money is paid over a length of time
words.sentence: My aunt made an installment payment on her bicycle.
words.fill: The monthly payment was an ___ toward the total price.

words.sentence: The peculiar bird had bright purple feathers.
The employee helped shoppers find their shoes.
words.fill: An ___ at the store showed me where to pay.

words.def: favored by or involving good luck or fortune
words.sentence: We were fortunate to find our lost keys.
words.fill: I felt ___ when my missing glove was returned.

words.def: lacking knowledge or awareness in general
words.sentence: Before the lesson, I was ignorant about how bees communicate.
words.fill: I was ___ about how volcanoes work until I read a book about them.

words.sentence: The quiet music gave the scene a melancholy feeling.
words.fill: The rainy ending gave the story a ___ mood.

words.sentence: My trustworthy friend returned the book she borrowed.
words.fill: He always keeps his promises, so I know he is ___.

words.def: A group of stars in the night sky that make up a picture or a pattern
words.sentence: We identified constellations in the night sky.
words.fill: At night we looked for ___ among the stars.

words.sentence: The irritating buzzing noise made it hard to concentrate.
words.fill: The constant tapping was ___ while I was reading.

words.def: To prevent something from continuing as usual
words.sentence: I was distracted by the loud noise during class.
words.fill: The sudden bell ___ me from finishing my sentence.

words.def: number of unit squares needed to cover the INSIDE of a shape or region
words.fill: The number of unit squares covering a shape is its ___.

words.def: a square that is 1 unit tall and 1 unit wide
to find the area of a rectangle, you multiply the length and the width
words.fill: To find the area of a rectangle, ___ the length and the width.
